status_definitions.current: GitHub represents the latest verified source/build version.
status_definitions.nonversioned_current: The repository is a current case study or source artifact without a release version.
status_definitions.github_source_authority: GitHub is the current source authority; an exact packaged Drive release may still be pending.
status_definitions.github_source_only: GitHub is the only registered source authority and no final Drive release is registered.
status_definitions.verified_successor_pending_exact_transfe: A newer final passed originating checks, but its exact bytes are not available for safe promotion.
status_definitions.verified_successor_under_reconciliation: A newer checksum-verified package is available and a security-preserving GitHub reconciliation is in progress.
status_definitions.verified_successor_unavailable: A newer historical candidate is recorded, but its exact package is unavailable or retired.
